newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary BCE f/x futures turnover hits record high.
newsitem.headline: Hungary BCE f/x futures turnover hits record high.

text.p: Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE)'s forex futures volume hit an all-time record on Friday as dealers gave up waiting for intervention to stop the mark's fall in world foreign exchange markets, dealers said.
After weeks of slack trade, the falling mark and Swiss franc made up 90 percent of the 19.88 billion forints ($101.4 million) total turnover, five billion forints above the previous high.
Hungary's forex futures markets are open only to domestic investors.

"Dealers were still waiting for the Bundesbank to try and stop the fall in the mark but nothing came, so now they're selling both the mark and the Swiss franc in large numbers," said Janos Szonyha of Swap Brokers.
The mark and Swiss franc fell in all maturities while nearby positions in the dollar rose.
Turnover on the smaller Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) was a negligible 1.1 million forints, done in one trade in December marks.
